name: AskForAttention_3
short_caption: The robot raises its right hand to its mouth level to politely clear its throat or ask for attention.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot raises its right arm, bringing a loosely closed fist up towards its mouth while turning its head slightly to its left. It holds this pose briefly as if clearing its throat or politely coughing to get someone's attention. Finally, it lowers its right arm back down to its side and returns its head to face forward in the neutral rest posture.
